profile_text.body:
Andreessen Horowitz, which also goes by a16z, describes itself on its site as a venture capital firm in Silicon Valley, California, investing in founders, innovators, and entrepreneurs building the future through technology. The site pairs that description with the phrase "Software Is Eating the World."

The firm was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California, according to its profile. It is a for-profit organization, and its website is a16z.com. No AI products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed under its name.

On the legal side, no individual cases are named for Andreessen Horowitz. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 237.
